$comment: Known unexplained >40% single-day closes pending an ADR-0002 lineage fix. Keys are 'SYMBOL@YYYY-MM-DD' (exact) or 'SYMBOL@~YYYY-MM-DD' (event anchor, ±14 days — backfills shift which row carries the step; the corporate-action date never moves). Every entry must cite evidence and the task that owns it. While entries exist, eod-cliff-sweep SKIPS (loudly) instead of failing every agent's gate for data debt nobody may fix mid-flight; anything NOT registered still hard-fails. When owning tasks land, entries are deleted and the gate returns to strict zero-tolerance automatically.
